svg.aria-label: Directoragent: An AI agent that takes a single photo and a scene description to produce a production-quality storyboard — a sequenced set of cinematic video clips with consistent characters, controlled camera grammar, and validated quality. Built on Higgsfield's MCP for generation (30+ models including Soul, Kling 3.0, Veo 3.1, Wan 2.6) with multi-phase planner.
